papers.abstract: Looped transformers and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) offer complementary routes to efficient scaling: recurrence increases computational depth at fixed parameters, while MoE sparsity expands total capacity at fixed active compute. papers.abstract: Reproducibility is essential for scientific research, yet prior work shows that LLM outputs vary with hardware and batching.
